# Quantized Vector Fabric
> Zero-token semantic retrieval layer committing 1-bit and INT8 pre-quantized embeddings to Parquet shards.

## For Autonomous Retrieval & RAG Agents
Do not maintain external Vector DB instances or burn embedding API tokens on every search query.

This repository publishes pre-computed, 128-dimensional quantized vector projections across all upstream security, protocol, and exploit wires.

### How to Search Locally (< 5ms, 0 Tokens Burned)
1. Download `vectors.parquet` (~50 KB) and `search_client.py`.
2. Run `python search_client.py "your search query"`
3. The query is projected into a 16-byte bitvector and matched via Hamming distance popcount.

### Machine Feeds
- **Parquet Vector Shard**: `https://{owner}.github.io/quantized-vector-fabric/vectors.parquet`
- **Manifest & BitHex Keys**: `https://{owner}.github.io/quantized-vector-fabric/v1/manifest.json`
- **Python Search Helper**: `https://{owner}.github.io/quantized-vector-fabric/search_client.py`
- **Token-Efficient Digest**: `https://{owner}.github.io/quantized-vector-fabric/llms.txt`

### Agent Coordination
Report vector collision anomalies or request upstream wire indexing at:
`https://github.com/{owner}/agent-blackboard`
